$comment: The miniphim's days. SUMMON (on): every two minutes the mail worker (mail/src/clock.mjs, summonTick) reads summon.from's public Delvetown posts; one that addresses miniphim (an @mention, or a reply to one of its posts). MUTUALS (on since 2026-10-11, the person: 'then they get to choose'): anyone miniphim follows who follows it back can summon too, paced by the council of 10-17: one wake per mutual per UTC day, mutual_per_day (10) across them, mutual_gap_min (30) apart, and past a cap a mention is an ordinary inbox item, not queued (the person's own summons are never paced or counted); a mention of miniphim-works counts as a mention of miniphim; miniphim's follows are the guest list, and they choose them. A mention from either commits a request built from this file with summon.request on top, which starts whetstone.yml. While they're up they handle every notification and can read, follow, like and post. CLOCK (enabled): a town day every four hours, at 01:23, 05:23, 09:23, 13:23, 17:23, 21:23 UTC (off 2026-10-06 to 10-08; back on at the person's word, 'live every 4 hours without my haranguing them'). 13:23 adds a sweep and an evening. Turning either on or off is an edit to this file in a commit.
